about: The recall each suite must keep (ADR 0027): positive-class recall for a detector, macro recall for a multi-class agent. dev and holdout floors were set from the round 5 measurement (intent, jargon and causal wording on blind set v4), rounded down to the whole per cent; the causal holdout was read while its fixes were chosen (ADR 0056) and the standards holdout was written by the session that wrote the patterns, so for those suites holdout is a second dev score and the floor is kept, not raised. The blind floor, added 22 October 2026, judges the split each suite declares as blind in scripts/evaluate_agents.py (causal and intent blind_v7, jargon blind_v6, standards blind_v1): written from the label definitions only, never looked at while fixing, and floored at the score measured that day rounded down. tests/test_evals.py fails when a change drops below any floor. figures_tool is the Tier 0 checker scored as a reviewer on the seeded memos in evals/reviewers (paragraph detection recall, with no false alarms).
